notes: GIVEN-WHEN-THEN (Gherkin BDD). All intelligence MUST go through the Claude API (incl. resume parsing); synthetic data only. P0 = demo-critical (protects the hero loop), P1 = important, P2 = nice-to-have. UPDATE (post-gate, 2026-06-05): existing IDs AC-01..AC-13 kept stable; AC-14..AC-20 appended for the new MVP requirements (Google OAuth, baseline skills, employee self-service, manager approval, resume extraction). AUTH OVERRIDE: real Google OAuth supersedes the fake-auth-only stance in SPEC §2/§8 and CLAUDE.md; AC-11 retained for role-based data scoping (now layered on the authenticated identity; a view-switcher may remain as a demo aid). REVISION (iteration 2, 2026-06-05): resolved reviewer findings PRD-R1-001..007. Existing IDs kept stable; AC-07 tightened (hero loop promotes the SAME skill record, not a duplicate) and AC-14 tightened (deterministic synthetic-handle mapping). Appended AC-21 (partial-quantity fulfillment), AC-22 (one canonical skill identity / trust-state promotion), AC-23 (idempotent cert+resume uploads), AC-24 (session expiry / re-auth mid-flow), AC-25 (Admin role assign/override). REVISION (iteration 3, 2026-06-05): resolved reviewer findings PRD-R2-001..003. Existing IDs kept stable; appended AC-26 (plan-validation gate for BR-11: >=2-3 items incl. >=1 AI-enabled, with non-conforming rejection + remove/swap flow) and AC-27 (manager 'endorsed' catalog flag set/unset + surfacing, non-manager denied). Added coverage_matrix rows for BR-11 and the endorsed flag.

acceptance_criteria.title: Certificate parsing via Claude (happy path)
acceptance_criteria.given: An employee on the Upskilling Tracker has selected a catalog item and a valid synthetic certificate (PDF or image) from fixtures/certs/
acceptance_criteria.when: The employee uploads the certificate
acceptance_criteria.then: The certificate is sent to the Claude API, which returns structured JSON {skill, issuer, date, level, confidence} that is Zod-validated, and on employee confirmation the skill is added to the profile with verified=true and source=certificate and the item status becomes done
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_notes: Parsing MUST be a Claude API call against fixtures/certs/ — no regex/keyword extraction. Run against the synthetic fixture set.

acceptance_criteria.title: Certificate parsing handles multi-skill / unusual certificate (edge)
acceptance_criteria.given: A synthetic certificate that lists multiple skills or an uncommon issuer/format
acceptance_criteria.when: The employee uploads it
acceptance_criteria.then: Claude returns all extracted skills in validated JSON and each confirmed skill is written to the profile as verified; ambiguous fields do not break the write
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_notes: Edge coverage for cert parsing variability.

acceptance_criteria.title: Certificate parsing failure / low confidence (error)
acceptance_criteria.given: An unreadable, non-certificate, or low-confidence file is uploaded
acceptance_criteria.when: Claude cannot reliably parse it or returns low confidence / invalid JSON
acceptance_criteria.then: No skill is written to the profile, the item remains in-progress, and the user sees 'We couldn’t reliably read this certificate. Check it’s a clear PDF or image and try again, or add the skill manually.'
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_notes: Protects data integrity: a failed parse must never create an unverified skill.

acceptance_criteria.title: Availability-aware ranked staffing match (happy path)
acceptance_criteria.given: A Manager/HR user and ~20-25 synthetic profiles with skills, allocation %, and freeFrom dates
acceptance_criteria.when: The manager submits a plain-English query such as '2 mid-level React + Node devs, free now or within 2 weeks, IST overlap'
acceptance_criteria.then: Claude returns a Zod-validated ranked shortlist where each entry has match %, matched skills, gaps, availability, and a one-line rationale, and the ranking reasons over availability (free now / free within 2 weeks), not skills alone
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_notes: Matching/ranking and availability reasoning MUST be Claude calls — no keyword search substitute.

acceptance_criteria.title: Hard match with no perfect fit returns closest people + gaps (edge)
acceptance_criteria.given: A query for a niche skill where no profile is a perfect fit
acceptance_criteria.when: The manager submits the query
acceptance_criteria.then: Claude returns the closest available people with explicit gap and ramp-up analysis (e.g. '~1 week of AWS ramp-up') rather than an empty result
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_notes: Demo scenario 2 (hard match).

acceptance_criteria.title: Partial-quantity staffing fulfillment (edge)
acceptance_criteria.given: A Manager/HR query requests a specific count (e.g. '3 mid-level React devs free within 2 weeks') but fewer than the requested count of profiles qualify
acceptance_criteria.when: The manager submits the query
acceptance_criteria.then: Claude returns the qualifying people that DO match (those fewer-than-requested results) accompanied by a clear note that fewer than the requested count were found (e.g. '2 of 3 requested qualify'), rather than returning an empty/zero-fit result or silently dropping the shortfall
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_notes: NEW (PRD-R1-006). Distinct from AC-05 (no perfect fit) and AC-06 (search failure): here SOME qualify but not the full requested quantity — return them with an explicit shortfall note. Quantity reasoning is part of the Claude match call (BR-04/BR-05).

acceptance_criteria.title: Staffing search failure (error)
acceptance_criteria.given: The Claude API is unreachable or returns output that fails Zod validation
acceptance_criteria.when: The manager submits a search
acceptance_criteria.then: No partial or garbled ranking is shown and the user sees 'Search is temporarily unavailable — please retry.'
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_notes: Resilience for the matcher flow.

acceptance_criteria.title: Close the loop — cert upload sharpens the next match (hero)
acceptance_criteria.given: A staffing search has surfaced a skill gap for a candidate and Claude has recommended a catalog item addressing it; the candidate may already hold that skill as a self-reported or manager-approved record
acceptance_criteria.when: The employee completes the item, uploads the certificate (AC-01 flow) so the SAME skill record is PROMOTED to verified (not duplicated, per BR-18), and the SAME staffing search is re-run
acceptance_criteria.then: The candidate’s match % and/or rank visibly improves compared to the pre-upload result, and the improvement is driven by the promoted trust state (raised matching weight) of the one canonical skill record — no duplicate skill row is created
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_notes: THE hero loop. Demo scenario 3. Protect above all. The before/after match compares the SAME skill record (BR-18 promotion changes its weight); a failed comparison would be a duplicated skill row instead of a promotion.

acceptance_criteria.title: Catalog de-dupe / normalize on add (happy + edge)
acceptance_criteria.given: The catalog already contains 'AWS Certified Solutions Architect'
acceptance_criteria.when: A user adds a near-duplicate such as 'AWS Solutions Architect'
acceptance_criteria.then: Claude de-dupes/normalizes the new entry and it is merged into the existing canonical item rather than creating a duplicate
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_notes: De-dupe MUST be a Claude call — no string-equality/regex matching.

acceptance_criteria.title: Catalog auto-tag and auto-enrich on add (happy path)
acceptance_criteria.given: A user adds a brand-new catalog item by name only
acceptance_criteria.when: The item is saved
acceptance_criteria.then: Claude auto-tags it (skill area, level, role relevance, AI-enabled?) and enriches it (description, typical duration, provider, prerequisites); if enrichment fails the item is saved with an enrichment-pending flag and the add is never blocked
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_notes: Tagging/enrichment MUST be Claude calls. Includes graceful-degradation error case.

acceptance_criteria.title: Claude recommends catalog items to an employee (happy path)
acceptance_criteria.given: An employee with a role, team, current skills, and matcher-surfaced gaps
acceptance_criteria.when: The employee views recommendations (e.g. empty-state on the tracker)
acceptance_criteria.then: Claude returns recommended catalog items relevant to that employee’s role/team/skills/gaps in validated JSON
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_notes: Feeds the loop (gap -> recommendation).

acceptance_criteria.title: Role-based data scoping (happy + unauthorized)
acceptance_criteria.given: An authenticated session resolved to a Practice Lead role (role layered on the authenticated identity; a role view-switcher may stand in as a demo/testing aid)
acceptance_criteria.when: The Practice Lead opens profiles and the progress view
acceptance_criteria.then: Only their team’s profiles and progress are shown; Manager/HR and Admin see the whole org; an Employee cannot access the Staffing Matcher
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_notes: UPDATED: role hierarchy now layers on REAL auth (see AC-14); role-based data scoping still required. A view-switcher may remain only as a demo/testing aid. Covers the unauthorized/scoping case.

acceptance_criteria.title: Team progress / compliance summary via Claude (happy + empty)
acceptance_criteria.given: A Manager or Practice Lead opens the progress view
acceptance_criteria.when: The view loads
acceptance_criteria.then: Claude summarizes who is on track, who is behind, and where skill coverage is thin (scoped to the viewer’s permission); a Practice Lead with no assigned team members sees 'No team members assigned yet.'
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_notes: Summarization MUST be a Claude call. Includes empty state.

acceptance_criteria.title: Synthetic-data and no-PII guardrail (constraint)
acceptance_criteria.given: The seeded profile dataset (~20-25) and certificate fixtures
acceptance_criteria.when: The repository, database, and fixtures are inspected
acceptance_criteria.then: No real names, emails, or PII are present — all data is synthetic — and the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is read from the environment, never hardcoded or committed
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_notes: Non-negotiable org and project rule.

acceptance_criteria.title: Google sign-in restricted to NULogic accounts (happy path)
acceptance_criteria.given: An unauthenticated visitor with a valid NULogic Google Workspace account (hosted-domain nulogic.io) for which a seeded synthetic-handle mapping entry exists
acceptance_criteria.when: They sign in / sign up via Google OAuth
acceptance_criteria.then: Authentication succeeds and the identity is resolved via the stable, seeded mapping (keyed by a synthetic handle, NOT the real email/PII) to the SAME synthetic employee profile and role every time, the user lands on their role-appropriate home, and no real user PII is persisted (the real email is used only transiently for the hosted-domain check and discarded)
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_notes: NEW + REVISED (PRD-R1-002). Deterministically testable on synthetic data: the identity→synthetic-profile mapping is stable and keyed by a synthetic handle per BR-13a, not real email/PII. Real OAuth supersedes SPEC §2/§8 and CLAUDE.md fake-auth-only. OAuth secrets read from env, never committed.

acceptance_criteria.title: Non-NULogic / unauthorized account is rejected (error)
acceptance_criteria.given: A visitor attempts to sign in with a non-NULogic Google account (wrong hosted domain) or an account with no mapped profile/authorization
acceptance_criteria.when: They complete the Google OAuth flow
acceptance_criteria.then: No session is created and the user sees 'Sign-in is restricted to NULogic accounts. Please use your @nulogic.io Google account.'
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_notes: NEW. Security boundary for the auth override; must reject non-nulogic identities. P0 because it guards access.

acceptance_criteria.title: Baseline current skills present on the employee profile (P0)
acceptance_criteria.given: A seeded synthetic employee profile
acceptance_criteria.when: The profile is inspected (by the employee or via the matcher dataset)
acceptance_criteria.then: It carries baseline/current skills (the skills held BEFORE any upskilling) distinct from upskilling-acquired cert-verified skills, plus the employee's current project and allocation/availability, and staffing matches can reason over these baseline skills
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_notes: NEW. P0 because matching depends on baseline skills + availability being present. Baseline = source self-reported/seeded; distinct from verified cert skills.

acceptance_criteria.title: Employee self-service skill add/update (happy + invalid)
acceptance_criteria.given: An authenticated Employee viewing their own profile
acceptance_criteria.when: They add or update a skill on their profile
acceptance_criteria.then: The skill is written with source=self-reported and state=self-reported (NOT verified, NOT yet manager-approved); a blank or invalid entry is rejected inline with no garbage written
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_notes: NEW. Employees manage their own skills; distinct from cert-verified and manager-approved states. Includes the invalid-input edge case.

acceptance_criteria.title: Manager approval of self-reported skills (happy + unauthorized)
acceptance_criteria.given: An employee has self-reported skills in state=self-reported and a Manager/HR with approval authority over that employee
acceptance_criteria.when: The manager reviews and approves a self-reported skill
acceptance_criteria.then: The skill state transitions self-reported -> manager-approved (a distinct state from cert-verified), and matching may weight manager-approved above unapproved self-reported; a user without approval authority (Employee, or a Practice Lead outside their team) cannot approve and the action is denied/unavailable
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_notes: NEW. Defines the skill state machine transition and the authorization boundary. Covers the unauthorized case.

acceptance_criteria.title: Resume upload + Claude extraction pre-populates profile (happy path)
acceptance_criteria.given: An authenticated Employee and a valid synthetic resume (PDF/doc/image) from fixtures/resumes/
acceptance_criteria.when: The employee uploads the resume
acceptance_criteria.then: The resume is sent to the Claude API which returns structured JSON (e.g. {currentProject, allocation, baselineSkills[]}) that is Zod-validated, and on employee confirmation the extracted details pre-populate the profile (baseline skills written source=self-reported) and feed skill matching
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_notes: NEW. Demo-relevant. Resume parsing MUST be a Claude API call with the same discipline as cert parsing — NO regex/keyword extraction. Resume is self-attested, so extracted skills are self-reported, not verified.

acceptance_criteria.title: Resume parsing failure degrades gracefully (error)
acceptance_criteria.given: An unreadable, non-resume, or low-confidence file, or Claude returns invalid JSON
acceptance_criteria.when: The employee uploads it
acceptance_criteria.then: Nothing is written to the profile (never writes garbage), the profile is unchanged, and the user sees 'We couldn't reliably read this resume. Try a clearer file, or add your details manually.'
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_notes: NEW. Data-integrity guardrail mirroring AC-03 for resumes: a failed parse must never write garbage profile data.

acceptance_criteria.title: One canonical skill identity per profile; trust state promotes on the same record (edge)
acceptance_criteria.given: An employee profile already carries a skill (e.g. 'TypeScript') in state self-reported (or manager-approved)
acceptance_criteria.when: The same skill is re-asserted via a higher-trust source — e.g. a manager approves it, or a certificate is parsed for that same skill (resolved by Claude semantic de-dupe, not string equality)
acceptance_criteria.then: The existing single skill record is PROMOTED in place along self-reported -> manager-approved -> verified (raising its matching weight) and NO duplicate skill row is created; re-asserting at an equal-or-lower trust is a no-op and never demotes the record
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_notes: NEW (PRD-R1-001, BR-18). Skill write path is an upsert keyed by (profileId, canonicalSkillId) with monotonic promotion. Directly underpins AC-07: the hero loop's before/after compares the SAME promoted record, not a duplicate.

acceptance_criteria.title: Idempotent / de-duplicated double-submit of cert or resume upload (edge)
acceptance_criteria.given: An authenticated Employee uploads a certificate (AC-01) or resume (AC-19), and the upload is submitted twice (double-click / retry / network re-send of the same file)
acceptance_criteria.when: The redundant submission is processed
acceptance_criteria.then: The profile converges to a single result — no duplicate skill record, no duplicate verified-skill promotion, and no duplicate resume pre-population — the redundant submit is ignored or resolves to the same single outcome, protecting data integrity and the loop
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_notes: NEW (PRD-R1-004, BR-19). Composes with AC-22/BR-18 (skill upsert) but also guards the upload action itself against double-submit. Applies to both cert (UC-1) and resume (UC-9) uploads.

acceptance_criteria.title: Expired session redirects to sign-in; in-flight work handled gracefully (error)
acceptance_criteria.given: An authenticated user whose session has expired (or become invalid) while a protected page/action is open, possibly with unsaved in-flight work
acceptance_criteria.when: They issue a request to a protected route or submit an action
acceptance_criteria.then: No protected data or action is served on the expired session; the user is redirected to the Google sign-in flow, and in-flight unsaved work is handled gracefully (not silently written under a stale identity, and on re-auth the user returns to a sensible place) rather than failing opaquely
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_notes: NEW (PRD-R1-003, BR-20). Real auth is in scope so session expiry must be covered. Minimal demo scope — no token-refresh machinery; just graceful redirect + no garbage write under a stale session.

acceptance_criteria.title: Admin assigns / overrides a user's role (happy + unauthorized)
acceptance_criteria.given: An authenticated Admin and a target (synthetic) user, plus a non-Admin user
acceptance_criteria.when: The Admin assigns or overrides the target user's role within the hierarchy (Admin > Manager/HR > Practice Lead > Employee)
acceptance_criteria.then: The target user's role is updated and their data access re-scopes accordingly (per AC-11 / BR-03); a non-Admin attempting the same action is denied; broader platform configuration is NOT available (out of scope for MVP)
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_notes: NEW (PRD-R1-005, BR-21). Minimal in-scope Admin capability = role assignment/override only, on synthetic profiles. Broader config deferred to roadmap (see scope-boundary).

acceptance_criteria.title: Upskilling plan validation — >=2-3 items including >=1 AI-enabled (happy + non-conforming + remove/swap)
acceptance_criteria.given: An authenticated Employee assembling their yearly upskilling plan from the catalog (catalog items carry an AI-enabled tag per AC-09/BR-07)
acceptance_criteria.when: They attempt to finalize/confirm the plan
acceptance_criteria.then: A conforming plan (>=2 items, and at least one of them AI-enabled) is accepted, marked complete, and counts toward the §8 upskilling-compliance metric; a non-conforming plan (fewer than 2 items, OR zero AI-enabled items) is REJECTED and NOT marked complete, the employee sees a specific message identifying which rule failed (e.g. 'Pick at least 2 items.' or 'At least one item must be AI-enabled.'), and the employee can remove or swap an item to bring the plan into conformance and re-attempt finalize
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_notes: NEW (PRD-R2-001, BR-11). The validating gate for the plan-minimum rule the §8 compliance metric depends on. Covers happy (accept + counts toward compliance), edge (remove/swap an item to reach conformance), and error (non-conforming attempt rejected with a specific message, plan not marked complete). The AI-enabled determination reuses the catalog AI-enabled tag (Claude-tagged per BR-07/AC-09); the count + AI-enabled check is a plan-validation constraint, not new intelligence.

acceptance_criteria.title: Manager 'endorsed' catalog flag — set/unset + surfacing (happy + unauthorized)
acceptance_criteria.given: A Manager/HR (or Admin) user and a catalog item, plus a non-manager user (Employee, or Practice Lead acting outside authority)
acceptance_criteria.when: The manager toggles the optional 'endorsed' flag on the catalog item (set, then unset)
acceptance_criteria.then: The item is marked endorsed (and can be un-endorsed), endorsed items are visibly indicated/surfaced in the catalog and recommendation views, and a non-manager attempting to set/unset 'endorsed' is denied — the toggle is unavailable/rejected for them; no endorsement WORKFLOW (multi-step review, approval chains, notifications) exists — only the single flag
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_notes: NEW (PRD-R2-003, BR-22). Specifies the optional manager 'endorsed' catalog flag that was in-scope but previously untested. Authorization-gated to manager/HR/Admin. Only the flag itself is in-scope; endorsement workflows remain out (scope-boundary creep risk). Endorsed state is surfaced/indicated to users (catalog + recommendations).

coverage_matrix.theme_or_rule: NEW: Partial-quantity staffing fulfillment — return fewer-than-requested qualifiers with a clear note (PRD-R1-006, BR-05)
The loop / hero capability — before/after compares the SAME promoted skill record (SPEC §6, BR-18)
Upskilling plan minimum: >=2-3 items incl. >=1 AI-enabled — validating gate the §8 compliance metric depends on (PRD-R2-001, BR-11)
NEW: Manager 'endorsed' catalog flag — set/unset (manager-only) + surfacing; flag only, no workflow (PRD-R2-003, BR-22)
Roles & data scoping layered on real auth (SPEC §3 [auth superseded], BR-03/BR-13)
Synthetic data / no PII / Claude-only intelligence (SPEC §10/§7, BR-09/BR-10)
NEW: Real Google OAuth restricted to NULogic + deterministic synthetic-handle mapping (supersedes SPEC §2/§8, CLAUDE.md fake-auth; BR-13/BR-13a)
NEW: Session expiry / re-auth mid-flow, in-flight work handled gracefully (PRD-R1-003, BR-20)
NEW: Baseline/current skills + availability on profile, distinct from upskilling-acquired (BR-16)
NEW: One canonical skill identity + trust-state promotion on the same record (PRD-R1-001, BR-18)
NEW: Skill state machine + manager approval authority (self-reported -> manager-approved -> verified) (BR-14/BR-15/BR-18)
NEW: Resume upload + Claude extraction (Zod-validated, graceful failure) (BR-17)
NEW: Idempotent / de-duped double-submit of cert + resume uploads (PRD-R1-004, BR-19)
NEW: Admin minimal role management — assign/override a user's role (PRD-R1-005, BR-21)
